title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service — Schedule of Return, Recall and Returned-Deposit Charges
content:
Charges and timelines for money that comes back on the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service — returned prefund deposits, payouts refused or sent back by the receiving card or bank, and recalls of payouts sent in error — are set per tier.

| Tier | Fee when a prefund deposit is returned unpaid (USD) | Returned deposits within 90 calendar days that suspend the service | Fee per returned disbursement (USD) | Business days after a return notice to credit the returned amount | Business days after settlement a same-day ACH payout may come back | Business days after a payout to a Paystride card within which a recall may be asked | Fee per recall request (USD) | Destinations a payout can be recalled from |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 35.00 | 2 | 2.50 | 2 | 2 | 1 | 10.00 | Paystride card |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 35.00 | 2 | 2.50 | 2 | 2 | 1 | 10.00 | Paystride card |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 30.00 | 2 | 2.00 | 2 | 2 | 1 | 7.50 | Paystride card |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 30.00 | 2 | 1.50 | 2 | 2 | 1 | 5.00 | Paystride card |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 25.00 | 2 | 1.00 | 2 | 2 | 1 | 5.00 | Paystride card |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 25.00 | 2 | 0.00 | 2 | 2 | 1 | 0.00 | Paystride card |

## Definitions

- **Returned deposit fee** — fee when a prefund deposit is returned unpaid (USD).
- **Suspension count** — returned deposits within 90 calendar days that suspend the service (count).
- **Return handling fee** — fee per disbursement returned by the receiving bank or card (USD).
- **Return credit time** — business days after a return notice within which the returned amount is credited to the prefund balance (count).
- **ACH return window** — business days after settlement within which a same-day ACH disbursement may come back as returned (count).
- **Recall window** — business days after a disbursement to a Paystride card within which the employer may ask to recall it as sent in error (count).
- **Recall fee** — fee per recall request (USD).
- **Recallable destinations** — destinations from which a disbursement can be recalled; on every tier this is the worker's Paystride card only.

## Reading the schedule

On Enterprise neither a returned disbursement nor a recall request carries a fee; the returned-deposit fee is charged on every tier.
